title: How to Kill Your Family On Christmas
overview: A pair off their rocker grandparents kidnap a 8th grader to present as a Christmas gift for their daughter and her husband. The preteen picks off the whacked out family one by one after being manipulated by the teen daughter of the couple.

title: The Girl in the Shadows
overview: A PTSD-ridden country cop is given the lead in a homicide case. Small town prejudices of sexual orientation and gender block her, as a secret she has been struggling with threatens to derail the case, her career, and, ultimately, her existence.

title: Chicken Boy
overview: Boris pursues masculinity and self-confidence through the teachings of social media guru Marcus Zain. But after a disastrous birthday party exposes his place within his friend group, bullying and his inner demons push him toward a monstrous transformation.

title: Don't Let Me Down
overview: When estranged friends Michael and Elizabeth reunite, Michael finds himself struggling to leave the past behind.

title: Motorgasm: a cinematic act of terrorism
overview: a nun sets out on a quest of bloody vengeance to kill the sadistic criminals responsible for her sister's death.

title: Ice Bros
overview: Two witless fish delivery guys are forced to dispose of a body by local gangsters, but soon discover the old lady in the bodybag is very much alive.

title: LATE NIGHT WITH NOBODY
overview: A look at the life and mess of Cooper Calhoun's chase for his dream.

title: One Day for Love
overview: After getting laid off from his startup job, Bayu runs an errand for his ex-girlfriend’s wealthy father to retrieve a rare designer bag. When the bag and a borrowed motorcycle are stolen, Bayu embarks on a wild chase across Jakarta alongside a washed-up child star and a hacker friend. Beyond the chaotic twists, Bayu learns to let go of high-society validation and embrace his own self-worth.

title: Violent Night 2
overview: When Santa forgets the true meaning of Christmas, he finds himself in the heart of a lively mall community in desperate need of his help. Sapped of his magic, he’ll need another way to take on the goons threatening the mall, and time is running out. Santa has to rediscover his faith in goodness and call in some last-minute reinforcements from the one person no baddie wants to tangle with: Mrs. Claus.

title: Ray Gunn
overview: In Metropia, a gigantic city in an alternate future as seen from 1939, private eye Raymond Gunn is drawn into a case involving aliens, murder and a multimedia star named Venus Nova.

title: Behemoth!
overview: Gifted cellist Alex Serian returns home to Los Angeles after 20 years on the road. Music, which has been the constant, all-consuming river of his life, begins to carry Alex on an adventure that will change him forever.

title: The Man with the Bag
overview: After Santa’s magic bag is stolen, he turns to his naughty list to find Vance, a thief, to help him get it back. Along with his daughter, Santa, and a group of misfits, Vance will have to pull off the greatest heist of his life to save Christmas.

title: Asterix: The Kingdom of Nubia
overview: The irreductible Gauls are turned into harmless children after a rare youth elixir accidentally ends up into the magic potion. To find the antidote and save the village from the Romans attack, Asterix and Obelix embark on a crazy journey to the far away Kingdom of Nubia.

title: In a Holidaze
overview: After making a romantic mistake of epic proportions, an aimless twentysomething finds herself trapped in a holiday time-loop, forced to relive the same Christmas at her family’s cabin until she discovers what truly makes her happy.

title: Flesh & Fuel
overview: A lonely French trucker's routine life on the road takes an unexpected turn when he encounters a Polish driver. As feelings develop, he struggles to balance his demanding job with a chance at love, determined to make their connection work.

title: One Minute to Midnight
overview: As he is about to separate from his partner, with whom he lives in Eastern France, 49-year-old Léo learns of the death of his biological father whom he never knew. Before traveling to Italy to deal with the inheritance, he spends a few days in Paris to take stock of his life. Between conversations with his activist daughter and encounters with ghosts from his past, he begins to question his very existence, and, above all, his relationships with women.

title: Le Faux Soir
overview: November 1943, German-occupied Belgium. In the face of grave danger if caught, the Independent Front, a Belgian resistance organization, publishes a spoof edition of Le Soir to satirize the German occupiers and the nation’s main propaganda-controlled newspaper. Le Faux Soir is considered the first act of media hacking in history.

title: The Education of Jane Cumming
overview: Edinburgh, 1810. Two female teachers find themselves at the centre of a scandal when one of their pupils accuses them of having a love affair.

title: Claude
overview: Two middle-aged siblings must navigate sharing custody of their recently divorced dad.

title: Tomorrow's Min-Jae
overview: Min-Jae, a promising athlete, is driven to the edge when a teammate benefits from a wealthy background, and she takes action. When her coach learns her secret, she is offered a deal.

title: Wi-Fi Love in the Palace
overview: A time travel romance across past and present, about a webtoon artist desperate for a hit and a palace maid who wants to become a royal concubine, connected by a mysterious cabinet.

title: World War II: Behind Enemy Lines
overview: Witness one US Army unit's battles, bravery and covert missions from D-Day to V-E Day in never-before-seen restored footage and rare firsthand accounts.

title: Bahr
overview: It follows a struggling young man facing the pressures of life and unemployment crises in the city of Port Said. Things take a turn when he falls for a girl who works in the circus, while entering into sharp confrontations and unexpected clashes with his opponents.

title: Pacer
overview: Fed up with a long-distance running champion who constantly humiliates him, Ian enters an underground race where hundreds of participants run until they collapse. The prize is a sum of money that could change his family’s life. In a game where stopping means death, the past he’s trying to escape seems to be catching up with him…

title: The Story of Wilfred
overview: A feature-length documentary charting the history and legacy of Adam Zwar and Jason Gann's cult classic 'Wilfred' featuring interviews with cast and creatives involved in the series.

title: Tramway Operation
overview: “L’Antenne est à nous” was a local television programme funded by the Seine-Saint-Denis Department and broadcast between 1986 and 1994. During those same years, a tramway line was introduced in the department, fifty years after this mode of transport had disappeared from the Île-de-France region. For their reports, the journalists of *L’Antenne est à nous* documented the return of the tramway. The film is made up of footage from the programme, rediscovered in the Departmental Archives.

title: Cattle Run
overview: Brothers living like strangers for over 30 years, Man-su and Byung-su raise cattle separately but get caught up in an unexpected crisis together.

title: No Choice
overview: No Choice is a short film about consequence, desperation, and the moments that push us beyond the point of turning back.

title: 2 Aile Arasında
overview: Sequel to 'In the Family' (2017). Plot TBA.

title: Zero A.D.: The Birth of Christ
overview: A star rises over Bethlehem as Christ is born. But when Herod orders the slaughter of the innocents, Mary and Joseph must protect the child promised to save the world.

title: Above the Below
overview: Three astronauts survive a violently destructive re-entry, only to discover their landing capsule is sinking into the uncharted depths of the ocean. Completely cut off from the world, they must battle both the sea and their isolation to survive.

title: Maserati: The Brothers
overview: Chronicles the Maserati family's journey, from its founding in 1914 to becoming a renowned Italian luxury car manufacturer, alongside rivals Ferrari and Lamborghini.

title: 3726 MDPL
overview: For four years, Rangga only dared to greet Andini through a phone screen. Mount Rinjani and its 3,726-meter peak become witnesses to his courage as he finally confesses the sincerity of his feelings. Andini welcomes his love, but behind her smile, doubt lingers. Bintang, the ex-boyfriend who once caused her deepest heartbreak, returns with regret, a changed attitude, and a declaration of love that is just as sincere. Along a climbing trail that tests both body and mind, Andini faces the biggest question of her life: move forward with someone new, or turn back to resolve the unfinished memories of the past?

title: Unholy Night
overview: The film centers on Gino, whose traditional Italian family Christmas Eve celebration descends into chaos when his deceased grandmother returns from the dead and embarks on a killing spree.  As more dead relatives begin appearing throughout the neighborhood, Gino must find a way to eliminate the holiday revenants and make it through the family gathering alive.

title: It Will Happen Tonight
overview: In Oslo, Thea and Matteo are awaiting the birth of their child. Meanwhile, in Mumbai, Charles asks Greta to marry him in public. Seven years later, in Rome, Matteo is playing tennis when Greta shows up for a match, dressed as a bride. For him it's love at first sight, but she's just married. Life goes on, yet Matteo cannot forget Greta. Seven years later, they meet again by chance; both are married and have children with other people. Love always brings them together at the wrong time. Loosely based on the short story collection "Legami" by Eshkol Nevo.

title: Fraggle Rock: A Holiday Gift
overview: It's the holiday season in Fraggle Rock, and Wembley can't wait to spread cheer as the Spirit Captain. But when the festive spirit starts fading, Wembley sets out to discover what truly makes the season special.

title: The Seoul Guardians
overview: On December 3, 2024, in Seoul, the President of South Korea Yoon Sukyeol declares the martial law. Troops move toward the National Assembly to seize control. Meanwhile, citizens rush to the National Assembly to block the troops, while lawmakers break through police's barricades at the main gate, climb over the walls to attend the session that lifts the martial law.

title: A Fabulous Weekend
overview: An ordinary Russian family goes to a digital detox hotel in the Murom region on the day when hordes of fabulous monsters suddenly begin to materialize in the real world. The only weapon against them is a mobile application.

title: Peak
overview: A mysterious man named Dmitriy Zorin arrives at the climbers camp one night, two days late, and immediately irritates everyone around him. No one knows who he is or why he's there, but he and a group of ten enthusiasts are set to ascend to the mountain's summit under the supervision of three guides. The experienced guides know the weather is turning bad and it's best to cancel the trip, but their desire to earn money is stronger. On the way to the 5,200-meter peak, they face blizzards, avalanches, wild animals, bitter cold, and conflict. But danger is not the main obstacle for Zorin and the others, because the closer they get to the summit, the more obvious it becomes: there's no escaping yourself; it's time to face your fears and the mistakes of your past.

title: The Christmas Ornament Library
overview: The meticulous librarian Alice Montgomery and newspaper reporter Noah Conrad discover a forgotten room hidden beneath their town's historic library, filled with hundreds of Christmas ornaments containing handwritten memories from generations past. As they set out to reunite each treasured keepsake with its rightful family, the pair rekindles a cherished Christmas tradition, strengthen an entire community, and discover that the greatest gifts of the season are the stories – and people – we carry in our hearts.

title: Robert Richardson: The White Devil
overview: What started as a student exercise and master’s degree project soon evolved into a creative partnership and personal friendship between Jana Hojdová, a former cinematography student at Prague’s FAMU, and distinguished cinematographer Robert Richardson.

title: Boss Cat
overview: When her mother suddenly dies, Sonja is thrown into tumult. Dealing with early-twenties existential angst and a sense of responsibility for her teenage younger sister Emma, she has a lot on her plate. Suddenly under the care of her controlling grandma and—as a young woman living with Down syndrome—constantly faced with a society that judges what she’s capable of, Sonja is desperate to be herself and take charge of her own life. When a chance encounter with the charismatic Hakim leads her to a krump class, Sonja discovers a life-changing outlet for expression.

title: The Christmas Gift Guide
overview: When a marketing exec who can suddenly hear Christmas wishes is paired with a momfluencer for a holiday gift guide, he must use his unusual new power to win her over—and the account—only to discover that the greatest gift may be love.

title: Очень сказочные дела
overview: All the inhabitants of the Far Far Away Kingdom are obsessed with three glorious heroes. Their battles are like rock concerts: they draw crowds of fans, merchandise is sold on every corner, and every child dreams of being like them. Among them is forty-year-old Elemelya, a simple-minded and awkward boy who also happens to be the president of the Three Heroes fan club, which includes three other children. At the royal feast, trying to get closer to his idols, Elemelya accidentally disrupts the knights secret operation to capture Koschey Bedrosovich. Koschey disappears along with the royal daughter. Now Elemelya is despised by everyone: the people, the tsar, his own fan club-but most importantly, he has disappointed his idols. To set things right, Elemelya, along with the chatty gusli player Alyoshka, sets off on a long journey to Koshchey's underbelly. Awaiting them are Baba Yaga, who is selling a hut on chicken legs.

title: Takdir Terakhir
overview: An ex-footballer joins a diving program with a group of disabled participants to uncover the truth behind the loss of his leg. But he embarks on a transformative underwater adventure that reveals a dangerous plot involving ocean poachers.

title: My Crazy Feminist Girlfriend
overview: After seven years, his ex returns as an unapologetic feminist, clashing head-on without compromising "love" nor "rights."

title: Sri Sri
overview: He loved a girl with no past and gave her a future... Now destiny returns to take her back, steeped in a forgotten life, buried memories and claims he cannot disprove.

title: together apart.
overview: Sophie and Jojo have been separated for six months but still live together like a couple. Only when Sophie's parents—who are unaware of the breakup—make their continued financial support conditional on her having a child with Jojo does movement come into the stagnant lives of the two millennials.

title: Ratu Petaka
overview: Behind the glitz and glamour of the Ratu Indonesia pageant, five beauty queen contestants harbor a dark secret: they are responsible for the death of a fellow contestant—a tragedy brought about by the bullying they inflicted upon her just before the grand final. To protect their reputations, they buried Mia’s body and vowed to keep the truth hidden. But following their victory, a mysterious terror begins to haunt them, one by one. The crowns they earned mark the beginning of their undoing—the consequence of their own actions.

title: Sow Leashes and Reap Dogs
overview: WWW Neurobeat is one of the pioneers of Czech rap, yet they never let themselves be bound by its rules. Alice Lacková’s documentary traces the band’s evolution from the 1990s to the present, primarily through interviews, archival footage, and concert recordings. How did an underground phenomenon become a unique artistic project straddling the boundaries of experimental music, poetry, and visual art? And how can the sound of a saw be transformed into music?

title: Till Death Do Us Part
overview: Plot Unknown.

title: Fatima
overview: A dedicated Islamic exorcist navigating a barrage of terrifying supernatural disturbances must confront her deepest spiritual vulnerabilities when an ancient, malicious force threatens to destroy both her patients and her soul.

title: Exchange
overview: A mother searching for her missing 18-year-old exchange student daughter in Canada. As she investigates, she discovers an eerie mystery surrounding the host family and is forced to confront forces that may have taken over her child's body.

title: Diva
overview: Maya, a child prodigy with a magical voice, becomes a star of the country's main opera house at the age of 11. Two envious prima ballerinas, from whom Maya has taken all the main parts, decide to get rid of the miracle of nature. Right on stage, the girl drinks a magic elixir and turns into a ghost. Later in the theater, Maya meets another stuck person - Iosef, an old conductor from the 19th century, who helps the girl and teaches her to live in new circumstances.

title: Hajatan Setan
overview: A young woman returns to her hometown after being away for years. However, her homecoming reopens old wounds and triggers a series of strange events that slowly engulf the villagers in suspicion and fear.

title: Unplanned Family
overview: When her mother falls ill, Gendis—a successful HR consultant—returns home furious. She resents her father, Sanca, a simple mechanic she blames for being absent during her childhood, and decides to take her mother away from him. However, Rima’s wish to bring them together forces Sanca to go to Jakarta, risking a massive secret from his past.

title: Olaya
overview: José Olaya, the national hero who defied the sea for Peru’s independence. A humble fisherman accepts the mission of crossing 23 kilometers of open sea, carrying crucial messages in the fight for freedom.

title: Gregorius, the Chosen One
overview: Gregorius, the Outcast. As an infant, he was abandoned by his own parents, conceived through the sinful love of a brother and sister. As a young man, misunderstood in a humble fishing village, he imagined the lake as an ocean, a small boat as a throne, and a spear as a royal sceptre. Yet deep within, he knew he was destined for something greater. Driven by a desire to become a knight and make the world a better place, Gregorius embarks on a journey that reveals the unfathomable ways of God. For within every sinner, there may also dwell a saint. Whether you are an outcast, a knight, a king, a hedgehog, or a pope, beneath the heavens there is ultimately only one true path: the path of a pure heart. Gregorius, the Chosen One.  Inspired by Thomas Mann's novel, Tomasz Mielnik's poetic absurd comedy transports audiences to a long-lost age, when the star-filled sky served as a map of endless, radiant, and irresistible journeys.

title: I Built a Rocket Imagining Your Arrival
overview: Fifty-something Rosa, lying in an MRI scanner, is prompted to summon a happy memory. She plunges into a meandering, subconscious road trip with her indomitable mother, both queer, where wild imagination becomes a tender, unruly form of therapy.

title: Yang Datang dan Yang Pergi
overview: Sinta (Dian Sastrowardoyo), the only daughter of Hartini (Retno Soetarto), inherits the family’s old Wiryo Guest House, a place that holds many memories from the past to the present. Amid the comings and goings of guests, Sinta is reunited with Banawan (Roy Sungkono), her childhood friend and the man she once loved. However, the presence of several other male guests brings with it hope, love, and betrayal, which slowly drag Sinta and her family into various problems.

title: Sumpah Keramat Mat Kilau
overview: The life and struggle of the legendary Pahang warrior, Mat Kilau, who lived in disguise for over 70 years.

title: 2m²
overview: Tayfun, an undertaker for the Belgian-Turkish community, must help families decide where their loved ones should be buried.

title: The Wildest Hunt
overview: Young biologist Marta Medved comes to the small town of Veliki Dabar to investigate the murder of a large bear, whose body has been discovered before the mayor's holiday home. Her arrival will suddenly wake up the sleepy highland town and its collection of seemingly normal residents, each with secrets of their own, including Marta's ex-husband Mauro and his agressive brother Mišel. To get to the bottom of the mystery at hand, Marta has to join forces with inspector Bolf, a kind hearted, but clumsy law enforcement officer, but, unbeknownst to both of them, they'll stumble upon a grand conspiracy that, in one way or another, involves the entire town.

title: Christmas Adventure
overview: A ballet dancer from Macedonia comes to Mačkat, on Zlatibor, to meet his future wife's family. The differences in customs and mentalities lead to a series of hilarious but also emotional moments.

title: 36 Ko Aankada
overview: Plot TBA.

title: Otra Mujer Sin Filtro
overview: Luisa is an uncompromising feminist, radical against patriarchy. Militates with passion, cancels without remorse, and does not tolerate anyone around him thinking differently. Ricardo, her partner, is a quiet and somewhat submissive psychologist who only wants to start a family with her, although Luisa considers motherhood a system trap. During a pro-abortion demonstration, Luisa is run over by the "truck of life" belonging to an ultra-Catholic group. When she wakes up, her personality has taken a complete turn: she dresses like a woman in her fifties, goes to mass, wants to have children, supports ultra-conservative ideas and is happy being a housewife. Ricardo, surprised, sees at first his greatest wish fulfilled. But he soon discovers that this new Luisa is homophobic, xenophobic and defender of a new kind of extremist ideas. Now, Ricardo, he will have to make a decision and find out which woman he is really in love with.

title: The Disney Ideology
overview: What do Cinderella, The Lion King, and an FBI informant have in common? They all tell the same story: that the world is already arranged exactly as it should be. In five acts, film critic Wolfgang M. Schmitt takes apart the world's biggest fairy-tale empire, exposing how Disney turns social hierarchies into laws of nature, romanticizes upward mobility as a fairy tale, and portrays every revolt as a threat. An essay film that will make you see the most familiar images of your childhood in an entirely different light.

title: Gianmarco Soresi: God Forbid
overview: Gianmarco Soresi makes his Netflix debut with sharp wit and offbeat insights, from the sanctity of the group chat to arguing as a love language.

title: Around Paradise
overview: In Caazapá, the “city of magic and legends”, two Paraguayan students are searching for happiness, gold and a magic bird. Their European dropout neighbours are hoping for freedom, healing and salvation from Armageddon. Everything has its price.

title: Diary of a Wimpy Kid Christmas: The Getaway
overview: With the stress of the holidays fast approaching, the Heffley family—to Greg's dismay—makes a last-minute decision to escape to an all-inclusive island resort for some much-needed rest and relaxation. As hilarious hijinks ensue, the Heffleys soon discover that paradise may not be everything it's cracked up to be.

title: Bokshi
overview: Anahita, traumatised by the brutal disappearance of her mother, finds comfort in Shalini, her history teacher. On an unconventional school excursion to a mysterious prehistoric site, she confronts her terrifying destiny.

title: Tender Loving Care
overview: Amy, a government child protection worker, moves back with her upbeat best friend Rosie, a social services officer facing daily anger and resentment. Amy's aging parents worry about her happiness while dealing with their own crisis.

title: Maatrubhumi:  May War Rest in Peace
overview: Based on the events that took place between the Indian and Chinese troops at the Galwan region on June 15, 2020 when 200 Indian soldiers bravely defended their territory against a force of 1200 Chinese Liberation Army soldiers

title: I See Buildings Fall like Lightning
overview: Childhood friends Patrick, Shiv, Rian, Oli, and Conor played together, skipped school together, and dreamt of the lives they would have one day. Now they’re thirty, and the future they imagined is slipping quietly out of reach.

title: Maverick: The Epic Adventures of David Lean
overview: Profiles the double Oscar winner, who helmed some of the most well-respected movies of all time, via never-before-seen archive and contributions from leading film directors. Haunted by the shadow of his dismissive father and his puritan upbringing, Lean was married six times, and he created layered and complex narratives in his work while struggling to find connection and meaning in his personal life.

title: A Long Winter
overview: After his mother disappears during the first blizzard of the season, a young man refuses to give up hope as one long Colorado winter reshapes his relationship with his father and his understanding of the man he is becoming.

title: The Friend's House is Here
overview: In Tehran’s underground art scene, Pari, a theater director, and Hanna, a dancer, are roommates, best friends, actors, and professional partners, navigating rehearsals, performances, and the quiet rituals of everyday life—until their secret circle is discovered. Shot covertly but far removed from familiar portrayals of Iran, directors Maryam Ataei and Hossein Keshavarz blur the boundaries between theatrical performance and lived experience, crafting a luminous portrait of sisterhood where art becomes inseparable from life and even the smallest creative choices can become acts of resistance.

title: Eetha
overview: Vithabai Narayangaonkar, a renowned Marathi Tamasha and Lavani performer rises from humble beginnings to become one of Maharashtra's most celebrated folk theatre artists.

title: Gods Don't Give Gifts
overview: "Gods Don't Give Gifts" traces the fallout of humanity besting earthly limitations like death and memory through technology and how it grapples with humanity as a result.

title: Trinidad
overview: Trinidad flees persecution in Spain for the wild west. Along the way, she earns renown for her weapons skills but also becomes a target of enemies, such as the widow Bronson.

title: LifeLike
overview: For the terminally ill Izzet, time is nearly up. Doctors have given up, prayers and rituals offer little help, and his family's future is now in God's hands. So Izzet spends his time in virtual reality, roaming through the astonishing and otherworldly places of the virtual cosmos. He even meets his girlfriend there…

title: Will You Still Be My Friend
overview: Amid an escalating feud in a rural Taiwanese village, a boy struggles to protect his secret friendship with his Singapore-raised best friend as adult conflicts threaten to tear them apart, while he quietly begins to question the true nature of his feelings for his friend.

title: The Secret Lives of Baba Segi's Wives
overview: A rich patriarch's delicate family falls apart when his youngest of four wives cannot have a child.

title: Alias Rukmini
overview: Krishna writes edgy and raunchy books under his wife Rukmini's name as a pseudonym, concealing his identity as the true author behind the provocative novels.

title: Leftover
overview: After learning a painful truth about their lost son, a forest officer and his wife set out in search of him, entering the forgotten world of the displaced and confronting what it means to be leftover.

title: Jönssonligan & Wall Enberg
overview: After being deceived by Wall Enberg, the Jönsson Gang decides to strike back with their most daring heist yet: to snatch Walls beloved artwork 'Pluto's Throne'—worth 400 million kronor, locked away in his private Franz Jäger vault. To succeed, they must outsmart a vain police chief, a desperate small-time gangster known as the 'The Shrimp', and Wall Enberg himself—who will stop at nothing to get his revenge.

title: Royal Puppies for Christmas
overview: When dog trainer Grace Walker is called to a European palace to tame mischievous royal corgis, she clashes with Prince William — but puppy chaos and Christmas magic lead to unexpected romance.

title: Demon Dancer: Sua/Nara
overview: After tragedy shatters her life, a professional ballerina allows a demon to possess her—transforming her body, movement, and rage into a deadly weapon.

title: Kaohsiung Breakout
overview: Adapted from the infamous Kaohsiung Prison riot in Taiwan, this story follows six inmates who plot a daring jailbreak to protest the injustices of the judicial system.

title: Tierra Viva
overview: A bittersweet drama and intimate road movie about the clash of two different worlds.  Marta, a once-popular Polish singer, receives devastating news of the sudden death of her adult son, Daniel, in Guatemala. Determined to bring his body home, she embarks on a long journey. Upon arrival, she is met by Marco—Daniel’s partner, whose existence she had known nothing about. Their shared trek through the dense countryside and remote Guatemalan wilderness—initially marked by mistrust and a struggle for control—slowly evolves into a moving confrontation with her own preconceptions about her late son and questions regarding the boundaries of intimacy. A sensual story set against the exotic landscapes of Guatemala, exploring grief, maternal love, and the challenging quest to understand the identities of those closest to us.

title: Cousin Isha
overview: After being publicly humiliated and heartbroken when his lover marries someone else, Ajit, the son of a small-town sweet shop owner, hits rock bottom-until Isha, his bold and fashionable distant cousin, unexpectedly enters his life, turning his pain into a potential new beginning.

title: Devi Mahathme
overview: Devi Mahathme is an Upcoming Kannada Thriller-Drama Directed by Nagaraj Somayaji and Starring Rangayana Raghu.

title: Baba
overview: Gourab, a journalist raised in an orphanage, dreams of becoming the perfect father more than a successful reporter. But when a dangerous child trafficking racket terrorizes Kolkata, he is forced to balance his duties as a husband, father, and journalist while risking everything to protect innocent children and uncover the truth.

title: The Snowflake Effect
overview: When driven corporate attorney Tanya rushes into a charming gift shop searching for a last-minute White Elephant gift, she crosses paths with Jason, a handsome, laid-back clerk. Their brief encounter leads Tanya to purchase a beautiful antique glass snowflake which, unbeknownst to her or Jason, is a good luck charm that carries a generations-old Christmas tradition. However, since the ornament is entered into a holiday gift exchange rather than gifted with proper intention, Tanya suddenly finds herself on the receiving end of everyone else's misfortune. After Jason's Aunt Coco explains the snowflake's magical lore, Tanya reluctantly teams up with Jason to track down the snowflake as it makes its way from one recipient to the next across Chicago before Christmas Day or she'll be stuck with bad luck until next Christmas.

title: Slava: Shooting with Music
overview: Sviatoslav Vakarchuk is the lead singer of Okean Elzy, Ukraine's most successful rock band. He is a former politician and activist who has a PhD in theoretical physics. Slava has been compared to Bruce Springsteen and Paul McCartney and his songs are an important part of Ukrainian identity, part of the country's cultural DNA. He is now channeling his talents to liberate his country.

title: Through the Eyes of Sera Flynn
overview: When a group of five soon-to-graduate high school seniors skip the last day of school, attempting to make it the best day possible, they slowly realize one of them is hiding a deep emotional struggle behind what seems to be the face of a happy teen.

title: Holly
overview: Holly arrives at church to pray for protection and  is greeted by an entity that craves her innocence.

title: TV Land
overview: After being diagnosed with a terminal illness, Will is given a second chance at life when a disturbed doctor forces him into an experimental procedure. He awakens in a strange world hidden behind a television screen, where reality and fantasy blur together. As he searches for a way back home, Will is forced to confront his past and discover what truly gives life meaning.

title: Sindure Jatra
overview: Plot TBA.

title: A Grand Biltmore Christmas
overview: In 1895, Elizabeth meets Michael, a teen trespasser at Biltmore House who vanishes. When he returns 20 years later, a magic hourglass pulls her to the present. She must return home before being found and before love alters her destiny.

title: Andre Rieu's 2026 Christmas Concert Let It Snow
overview: Andre Rieu's annual concert celebrating the magic of Christmas.

title: The Catstody War
overview: Married couple in their 5th year of marriage, about to get divorced, and their conflict over the 'cat rights' of a cat that is like a child to them.

title: Samson and Delilah
overview: Sacred, scandalous, and irresistibly alluring, Saint-Saëns’s spectacular take on the biblical hero of legendary strength and the seductive Philistine whose beauty overpowers him returns in the Met’s larger-than-life production. Featuring a massive orchestra and chorus and some of opera’s most spellbinding tunes, this masterpiece of French grand opera is a feast for the eyes and ears. Giacomo Sagripanti conducts an electrifying cast led by the formidable star pairing of mezzo-soprano Aigul Akhmetshina and tenor Clay Hilley, transmitted live to cinemas worldwide. This live cinema transmission is part of The Met: Live in HD series, bringing opera to movie theaters across the globe.

title: Anchorless
overview: During a trip to Brazil in 2022, Augusto (15), an introspective and dreamy young man, becomes enchanted by Antônio (16), a magnetic and unpredictable boy from Belém. Amid the heat of the World Cup and the waters reflecting a fleeting encounter, a fragile connection is born, stretching across distance when Augusto returns to Italy, turning desire into obsession. While Augusto loses himself in idealizations and the emptiness of delayed responses, Antônio continues his life between parties, friends, and fleeting loves. What begins as a promising romance crumbles under the weight of time, silence, and the things that were never said. As the years pass, Augusto is forced to face an inevitable truth: some loves do not belong to the future, they exist only in memory. An intimate and visceral portrait of love, loss, and growth, Anchorless delves into the fragility of first feelings and the pain of learning that not every story is destined to last.

title: It's A Girl Thang
overview: In 1997, a girl group's home-video shoot falls apart as its tyrannical leader fires each member one by one, until she's the only one left.

title: Regresa
overview: After the tragic death of her son, Phoebe is invited to a remote Mexican village to grieve, but she instead finds a cult in a Raramuri sacred land that claims they can raise her son from the dead.

title: Superplastic Deformation
overview: Five boxes arrive at a woman's home. Inside are diaries and manuscripts left behind by a high school student, Michiko Ono. An encounter with a transfer student appears before Michiko. Unexpected events await her. Terrifying memories are written down. The boundary between reality and fantasy begins to waver. Can Michiko's blood-stained heart, which has undergone “superplastic deformation”, ever return to its original shape? After reading everything Michiko sent her, the woman arrives at a shocking truth...

title: Christmas from the Heart
overview: A grieving widow travels to Lisbon to meet the recipient of her late husband's heart, only to fall for the woman's brother.

title: Precipice
overview: A profoundly working-class community with an intense connection to its land and water is transformed into a pleasure paradise for the wealthy…all while the ground slips into the sea. A feature documentary, PRECIPICE focuses on the intersection between climate change and a changing shore community’s response to this global emergency.

title: Ken
overview: Ken is retired and so is his zest for life, till his wife meets a handsome stranger.

title: Hard Craft
overview: A widow coping with a recent loss has an eerie encounter with a figure dressed as a living statue on the street. After offering a coin and expecting some kind of entertaining performance, she ends up having to fight for her life.

title: 아기상어 크리스마스 스페셜: 산타 선발 대회
Castration Movie ⅗ Year of the Hyaena
overview: Michaela tries her best to be a good person.

title: The Magnificent Raiders of Dimension War One
overview: A collection of rogues must gather information on a mysterious extra-dimensional threat to the galaxy in the 43rd century, and prepare a defense while fending off the first wave of attacks from horrific beings.

title: An Angel in My Stocking
overview: Three years after a disastrous marriage, Amanda unexpectedly gets stranded with her ex-husband Jack in a remote Vermont town, where a mysterious traveler claiming to be her guardian angel pushes them to confront their past.

title: Christmas by the Spoonful
overview: When a food critic with no culinary abilities of her own is tasked with preparing her family's first Christmas dinner since the passing of their beloved matriarch, she is forced to enlist the help of a local French food truck owner whom she nearly put out of business with a bad review.

title: Mending Hearts for Christmas
overview: An events coordinator reunites a veteran with his estranged son, who unexpectedly falls for the woman responsible for bringing them back together.

title: Yes, Santa
overview: When stressed-out single mom Dorothy falls under a magical holiday curse that forces her to say “yes” to every Christmas request, she’s thrown into a whirlwind of festive chaos. But with the help of her cheerful (and handsome) neighbor Walter, she just might rediscover the joy of the season.

title: Maishafko Rupa
overview: Maishafko Mohani is a romantic musical story about a Dangali prince and a beautiful Rukum princess. One night, the prince dreams of meeting his dream princess at the enchanting Godawari Park in Lalitpur. As he approaches her, they share a magical connection filled with joy, romance, and beautiful dance moments. In his dream, the prince expresses his admiration for her beauty, grace, and charming personality. As their bond grows stronger, he proposes marriage to her, and she happily accepts his proposal. Together, they celebrate their love through playful moments, romantic dances, and heartfelt expressions. The song takes viewers on a dreamy journey where love feels limitless and reality fades away. Through colorful visuals, graceful performances, and romantic chemistry, Maishafko Mohani portrays the timeless fantasy of finding one’s perfect love. It is a beautiful dream of a prince who sees his beloved princess as the most beautiful woman in his world.

title: MILE SixTONES Stadium Tour
overview: SixTONES first stadium tour, MILESixTONES, held to commemorate the group's sixth anniversary since debut. This release features the group's performance at Yanmar Stadium Nagai and is available exclusively on Netflix.

title: Sock It to Me: The Legend of George Schlatter
overview: Recalling a seven-decade career as a prolific TV producer and director, George Schlatter created Rowan & Martin’s Laugh-In, the groundbreaking comedy variety hour that launched on NBC in 1968.

title: The Test
overview: Caught between a pro bono murder investigation and a law school reunion, Mike Leonardo reconnects with classmates for a weekend to celebrate the past. But when buried secrets surface the reunion curdles into something far more dangerous.

title: Violette
overview: Violette Toussaint, a cemetery caretaker in a small town in Burgundy, is a unique observer and a compassionate listener. Her peaceful life is filled by conversations with quirky cemetery workers and the many visitors who share their stories of love, loss, and life. However, her routine is disrupted when a local police chief arrives at her door with an unusual request. As they grow closer, Violette comes to understand that the truth behind long-buried mysteries in her past must be uncovered if she wants to take another chance on life and, against all odds, love.

title: Rewind Barcelona
overview: Hascoët, Émile, Léo, and Paul are a rowdy group of teenage skateboarders. They pile into Léo’s mom’s car and drive to Barcelona, the mecca of skateboarding, for their first trip away as almost-adults. They live on vacuum-sealed tortillas, drink warm cans of Lemon Damm, and spend their days and nights at MACBA. The beach might as well not exist, and the Sagrada Família is just something they pass on the way. All that matters is skating, drifting through the city, and burning through those first fragile days of freedom. Ten years later, they try to piece it back together over a few scattered phone calls. The memories are still there, but something has shifted. What once felt infinite now comes back in fragments.

title: Rehearsals for a Revolution
overview: Through five portraits of relatives and mentors, five expressions of resistance, Pegah Ahangarani sketches her life story. Drawing from personal archives, home videos, street protests footage, newspapers, and recorded voices, she retraces more than 40 years of Iran’s history. From the early days of 1979, until the war that began in 2026, she pieces together intimate and collective memories, forming the portrait of a country shaped by political repression and in constant hope for a revolution.

title: Bluefish
overview: Fresh out of prison, Gwang-su, a physically impaired ex-thug, returns to his quiet seaside hometown of Yeongdeok. Hardened by years of violence, he drifts through the harbor town doing odd jobs for a small-time gang involved in a shady redevelopment project. After mistakenly assaulting Yeon-jeon, a mute single mother, Gwang-su is confronted with guilt and the fragile humanity he thought he had lost. As an unlikely bond forms between them, he learns that the redevelopment scheme will force her and her son from their home. Caught between loyalty to the gang and the chance for redemption, Gwang-su must decide whether to remain part of the violence—or risk everything to protect the only people who have shown him kindness.

title: Three Weeks Under the Sea
overview: Ukraine after the annexation. Haunted and reckless, Mykhailo returns to bury his father, only to discover that the old man has effectively been a ghost for 20 years. Like Schrödinger's cat, he seems ready to reappear at any moment.

title: How to Dance
overview: When every movement is watched, the body finds new ways to express truth and resistance beyond language.

title: The Debut
overview: When Mona Friedman is cast in a bit part at a small community theater, she transforms from a shy, unassuming housewife into a zealous method actor willing to do anything to protect the artistic integrity of her marginal role—even if it means waging war against the show’s domineering director.

title: Ink
overview: After buying a struggling British tabloid in 1969, mogul Rupert Murdoch and editor Larry Lamb banded together a group of misfits and visionaries to reshape the image of the news industry as we know it.

title: Frank & Louis
overview: Frank, serving a life sentence, takes a prison job caring for aging incarcerated men with Alzheimer’s and dementia. What begins as a self-interested bid for parole becomes a profound, transformative bond with fellow prisoner Louis, offering Frank a glimpse of redemption in an unforgiving place.

title: Forelock
overview: A naive fitness enthusiast looks for a fresh start in Los Angeles, but collides with a Hollywood Boulevard grifter who exploits his uncanny resemblance to the world's most famous superhero.

title: Jani Be Good
overview: Ten days after her sister Julia leaves home without a word, Jani (13) wants only one thing: her return. Jani knows her mother, Winnie, is the reason Julia left, and the two are growing distant while Winnie buries her guilt in work. Only Oma, the grandmother, comforts Jani. Unknown to Winnie and Oma, Jani secretly keeps in touch with Julia. Over four December days, Jani must choose: stay silent or confront her mother.

title: Permafrost
overview: Follows Marcus Tell and Ann Wilding, the Swedish police's most unlikely duo, forced to unite when their seemingly vastly different investigations lead to the same dramatic conclusion: an attack during Stockholm's Nobel Week.

title: Chimera
overview: Geneticist Ivan Rozin, unable to come to terms with the loss of his beloved mother, is obsessively working on a scientific project to find a cure for death and improve the human genome. Violating more and more ethical norms, a scientist absorbed in this idea kidnaps two children. Their mother will have to stop Ivan and prove that his experiments do not lead to perfection, but to the loss of humanity by himself.

title: Para Vigo Me Voy!
overview: A Documentary about the Brazilian Filmmaker Carlos Diegues and His Works.

title: Yesterday Island
overview: When failed novelist Amos agrees to mind his friend's research station on a remote island for just one day, he expects solitude and a chance to break his writer's block. But when his friend fails to return, Amos discovers he has been deliberately trapped in a bizarre time loop. In a desperate attempt to escape "yesterday", Amos coaxes his ex-wife onto the island, but instead strands them both there. To ensure their own freedom, the two must scheme to invite their most dislikeable friends to the island, with unforeseen and messy consequences. A quirky dark comedy about second chances, petty revenge, and the ultimate importance of forgiveness.

title: Yolki 13
overview: The stories of people's destinies, intertwined by genuine New Year's magic and sorcery in one grand story, are told through the serial number of the new installment, a symbol of change and transformation. The hero of one of the short stories, filming of which recently concluded in Moscow, is a wayward businessman named Igor, who finds himself caught in a whirlwind of adventures on New Year's Eve: a fortune teller places a curse on him that can only be lifted by reuniting with his daughter, whose existence Igor has long preferred to forget. He turns to the renowned and fashionable psychic Aleksandr Sheps for help. Furthermore, Igor must discover what truly matters most in life.

title: Talented
overview: Tereza is a single mother who juggles teaching dance and caring for her daughter, Pina, with help only from her elderly father. Her life is turned upside down when her daughter joins a children's talent show. Pina wants to reach the finals in Rio de Janeiro, hoping to return to her hometown. As they rehearse, the girl reignites dreams from her mother's past.

title: A Christmas Cookie Caper: A Puzzle Time Mystery
overview: When a celebrity baker is found unconscious during Winter Haven's 100th Annual Christmas Cookie Challenge, amateur sleuth Vera Vexley races to clear her friend's name. With stolen recipes, hidden secrets and a cryptic crossword clue leading the way, Vera must solve the mystery before Christmas.

title: Die Heilung – Eine Geschichte vom Weitermachen
overview: In 1999, doctoral student Ingmar Hoerr accidentally discovers revolutionary mRNA vaccine technology at the University of Tübingen, Germany—the same technology that would later protect millions from Covid-19. Despite initial ridicule from Nobel laureates and experts, Hoerr perseveres and founds his own company to develop the first vaccine based on mRNA technology. With the Covid-19 pandemic emerging in 2020, everything changes. Suddenly, governments and people around the world pin their hopes on the technology he invented, believing it could save the world. But when Hoerr is called to Berlin by the German government, fate intervenes and his focus shifts from saving humanity to saving himself.

title: Il mio nemico immaginario
overview: Emma, a curious and imaginative nine-year-old girl, loves unicorns, spaceships, and Christmas trees. She lives with her quirky family: her mother Sara, a molecular gastronomy enthusiast; her sharp-witted grandmother Loredana; and her stern father Leo, a science teacher worried about the fantasy world Emma inhabits. Emma’s imaginary friend, Mojito, helps her escape reality, but her parents—on the verge of separation—struggle to understand her. Meanwhile, Bob, Leo’s long-forgotten imaginary friend, reappears, trying to reconnect with him before vanishing forever. The story explores Emma’s journey to find a balance between her dreams, reality, and her family dynamics.

title: Sara
overview: Sara, a transgender woman goes back to her remote hometown to attend her father’s funeral. She finds the village has changed greatly, and that the villagers have become extremely religious. Added to that, her mother suffers from dementia and treats her like a complete stranger.

title: The Kingdom of Rexmonte
overview: When a Sudden Invasion threatens their kingdom, a fractured royal family must face their long-avoided differences in order to protect their denizens, restore the peace, and secure their domain.

title: Atividade Paranormal: Portal Para o Mundo Fatal
12 Mile: Guiding the Archipelago
overview: A documentary film about Prof. Mochtar Kusumaatmadja.

title: Родная кровь
overview: Eighteen-year-old Sonya, who lost her memory in a car accident, remembers neither her home nor the parents who care for her—yet also surround her with strange prohibitions. Soon, she begins to suspect there is a ghost in the house, one warning her that her loving parents are not at all who they claim to be.

title: Scenario
overview: Altmark is located in the northern part of the German region of Saxony-Anhalt. This area of the country is sparsely populated and rural, and is mostly defined by agriculture and a rather frugal architecture reminiscent of that of the Hanseatic cities. It's here that an extensive military site was built in the 1930s. It is used as a training area for the German army and also includes a garrison town, in which parts of the military corps reside. The site covers a surface area of 323 square kilometres. It is the third-biggest military area in Germany and the most modern in Europe.

title: Bad Day
overview: On one of the worst and wildest days of her life, single mom Joy fights to keep one little promise to her daughter.

title: Bunker
overview: When an architect accepts a morally ambiguous project — building a survivalist bunker for a tech billionaire — his wife of 17 years begins to question their relationship.

title: Killing Castro
overview: In 1960, Fidel Castro comes to America to speak at the UN. He is invited by Malcolm X to stay in Harlem at the famous Hotel Theresa. Unsure of his intentions, the FBI, CIA and the Mafia, all attempt to eliminate him by any means necessary.

title: Clarissa
overview: Across a single day in Lagos, Nigeria, Clarissa prepares to host a high society party at her home, as her complicated past begins to consume her, in the form of now-distant friends and loves from her youth. Simultaneously, Septimus, a young soldier, is haunted by his own memories of the horrors he has witnessed and endured. As the perspectives traverse past and present, across the bourgeois class and those too easily forgotten by society, a delicate portrait of contemporary Nigeria emerges.

title: Earth Song
overview: Rojin, a Kurdish-Finnish woman in Helsinki, faces upheaval when her father unexpectedly visits, forcing her to confront her past. Her family life with husband Ferhat and adopted daughter Azad unravels, revealing a complicated history.

title: The Apothecary Diaries: The Late Lady's Treasure
overview: The emperor gives Jinshi an order: He must grant the final wish of a concubine who passed away five years ago by returning her to her homeland. In order to return her to her family, Jinshi examines the remains, only to discover that they're in pristine condition. To solve the mystery of the remains, Jinshi drags Maomao along on a journey to Binan-shu, the southern province ruled by the Bi clan. Maomao is excited to see herbs and medicines she has never seen before, but tensions are high in the area, as pirates are viciously trying to find the treasure their late leader hid away. On the day of the concubine's funeral, a huge incident occurs, triggering a chain of events that nobody could see coming.

title: Where the River Takes You
overview: During a farewell carnival, a young artist falls for a stranger who hides a supernatural secret.

title: Straight Circle
overview: A pair of enemy soldiers stationed on a remote border in a vast featureless desert descend into a state of profound disorientation after forgetting which side of the border is which. As they grapple with their identities, loyalties, and the absurdity of their situation, their isolation slowly gives way to an unfathomable nightmare that will blur the line between friend and foe.

title: The Canary's Lullaby
overview: In a storm-scared village, 70-year-old Tae lives a quiet life until she rescues Haru, a mysterious mountain creature. As she feeds and nurtures him with her wanzi, she finds a renewed sense of purpose. However, when rumors of a monster spread, fear turns the villagers against them. Tae is forcibly hospitalized, and Haru is hunted as a harbinger of disaster. To protect him, she stages a fake funeral. When a new storm strikes, Tae must learn that love is not possession but letting go.

title: The Bitch Pack
overview: Luna, a misunderstood teenager, is accused of abuse by her own father and locked up in a juvenile detention center to await her final hearing. When her passion for urban music begins to catch the attention of her fellow inmates, she glimpses a different way to survive on the inside.

title: Mr. Bhaarath
overview: Two siblings share a unique bond where, according to their zodiac signs, any good fortune experienced by one is believed to be reflected in the other's life. Believing in this connection, they decide to get married at the same time. However, their plans take an unexpected turn when one sibling's childish behavior creates a series of complications, leading to emotional and family conflicts that put both weddings at risk.

title: Jasmine & Jambo
overview: A prequel of the series that explains how Jasmine and Jambo met and why they became so friends. An emotional and musical journey to save music.

title: Samo Lives
overview: A vibrant portrait of Jean-Michel Basquiat, the NYC artist who revolutionized 1980s art. From street graffiti to gallery stardom, his bold Neo-expressionist works left an indelible mark on the art world and beyond.

title: Tutu
overview: Through never-before-seen archival footage and first-hand accounts of those who knew him best, the film traces Archbishop Desmond Tutu’s rise as the voice of the oppressed, guided by faith, hope and an understanding of the power of forgiveness.

title: The Holiday Trilogy
overview: Three interconnected tales of distorted human connection come together to form a melancholic portrait about the complicated emotions that surround the holidays.  Each chapter is shot by a different Los Angeles-based SOV (Shot-on-Video) filmmaker .

title: Pocket rockkets
overview: A fun heist entertainer

title: Duped (The Jezbel Experience)
overview: Alexandria Wright meets Elijah Martinez and the demonic journey begins. Elijah Martinez finds himself ensnared in a romantic involvement with Alexandria Wright, an unfaithful Covert Narcissist. She convinces him they are soulmates and they take a vow before God for His blessing with the penalty of betrayal being death. After years pass, Alexandria forgets the vows and begins cheating behind Elijah's back. Just a week before Christmas, she abruptly betrays him. To his astonishment, she swiftly transitions to a new relationship, bringing with her the unsettling secret of transmitting an incurable sexually transmitted disease to her new partner. Then came Karma. Her victims arrive to spit on her dirty grave as her demise finally arrives.

title: Take Care Bhalobasha
overview: Upcoming Bengali movie slated for 2026 release.

title: American Baby
overview: Oli becomes an outcast in her community when she gets pregnant at 15. As she seeks out the suddenly absent teenage father-to-be, Oli confronts the growing isolation from her community.

title: Monster in Sheep's Clothing
overview: It depicts the relationship between university student Kusakabe Daichi and Igawa Jun, the seemingly perfect and handsome fiancé of Daichi's older sister.  Although Daichi finds Igawa suspicious precisely because he seems to have no flaws whatsoever, he gradually finds himself drawn to him. However, Igawa has a hidden side that no one knows about.

title: The Four: No One Fights Alone
overview: Shifting from her usual comedic angles to an emotionally charged, character-driven drama, the narrative revolves around Esosa and three fiercely loyal women. When a high-stakes crisis threatens the future of a young man they collectively love, their courage, faith, and mutual bonds are pushed to unimaginable limits.

title: Super Space Sheriff Gavan Infinity VS Raiya
overview: Seeking the truth behind the "Biscatonic Cluster  Incident", which claimed an unprecedented number of victims and turned Death Gavan evil, Gavan Infinity —Reiji Doki— sets out for Planet Alkam, one of the planets where the incident took place. There, Gavan Raiya —Kunai Kazanami— who was tracking Death Gavan’s whereabouts, also appears from across dimensions…

title: Ripple in a Pond of Blood
overview: A woman’s attempt to resurrect her deceased dog through occult rituals goes horribly wrong—tearing a hole in reality and unleashing a slow, surreal descent into violence and madness.

title: Earthlings in Love
overview: In 2000, high schooler Shinpei asks his crush, Mai, to star in his first film. In 2025, now a director, he lives with young-onset dementia.

title: Christmas in Canterbury
overview: A festive romance film

title: Censored
overview: Spain 1969. After the death of her brother, a young, dyslexic organist begins a forbidden love affair with an idealistic woman who pushes her to write a song and rebel against the highly censorious and conservative society ruled by the dictator Franco.

title: Far From the Trees
overview: Adela, a Mexican sound artist, travels from the jungle to the Peruvian Andes alongside Lucho, a guide and translator. Following the legacy of her grandfather, a Republican exiled in Mexico, she weaves a sound map of endangered languages. When the fear of death breaks in, reality fractures. The journey turns into an intimate passage that confronts her with memory, grief, uprooting and identity.

title: The Chain of Roses
overview: Waking up handcuffed together after a violent crash, a man and a woman find themselves on the run from both the police and ruthless drug dealers. With no memories of the past, they are unsure which of them is the cop and who is the criminal.

title: this is real.
overview: Three college friends strive to make a true crime documentary about a string of vandalisms, but after they are led to a dead end, one of the friends decides to twist the footage into something more sinister.

title: The Voice Still Carries: The Aimee Mann Story
overview: Chronicles the life of singer-songwriter Aimee Mann; from her early life to her eventual triumph over the music industry as the tentpole indie artist of her generation, and how she continues to inspire artists to this day.

title: Snow Globe Town
overview: Emily Church joins her sister Zoe and Zoe’s longtime boyfriend on a Christmas getaway to Pine Grove, a town famous for its romantic holiday traditions. While helping with Zoe’s proposal plans, Emily is paired with skeptical journalist Bert Baxter. As they are drawn into the town’s festive celebrations, unexpected feelings begin to challenge what they both thought they knew about love, family and Christmas.

title: Hidden Love
overview: Sang Zhi quietly falls for Duan Jiaxu, her older brother’s college roommate. Years later, a chance reunion allows their once-hidden feelings to resurface, gradually turning an unspoken crush into a heartfelt romance.

title: The River Remains the Same
overview: After years away from home, Pedro returns to the small town where he grew up to visit his gravely ill father. As he struggles to mend a relationship long defined by silence, he finds himself reunited with his first love, confronting the memories and feelings he left behind. In the process, he comes to realize that the past is not a place we can return to, but something we carry with us, shaping who we become.

title: Making Christmas Bright
overview: ​In Making Christmas Bright, Kay, is a devoted middle school teacher in the close-knit Kentucky town of White Grove who believes God has opened the door to an exciting new career and a new life in the city. With Christmas approaching, Kay is preparing to leave behind her father, lifelong friends, students and the community she has always called home. But when she volunteers for her small-town church’s “Christmas Angel Tree” project, and is paired with Joshua, a newly arrived police officer looking for a fresh start of his own, an act of service begins changing both of their lives.

title: Ananke
overview: In a dystopian future, the population is prohibited from having sexual relations. However, this measure will only come into effect at 12:00 a.m.

title: Mistletoe in Mexico
overview: A widowed sociology professor travels to Mexico following her son's surprise elopement and falls for the bride's godfather, a tech CEO who moonlights as a Lucha Libre wrestler.

title: Unmatched
overview: Charlie finds himself caught in a time loop inside a dream, reliving an awkward encounter again and again, each time hoping for a different outcome.

title: A Very Evergreen Christmas
overview: Abby inherits her aunt's tree farm under the condition she spends two weeks working there. With the help from Ethan, the farm's longtime caretaker and Abby's best childhood friend, Abby learns that the farm is much more than just a place.

title: Noelle Nomads
overview: Before they can embark on their luxurious Hawaiian holiday, uptight sports medicine physician Joseph and his daughter Annie must first begrudgingly make a pit stop at a remote campground and deliver a package from his late father to a mysterious person named Birdie. Their plans are derailed when Joseph accidentally crashes into free-spirited Nora's RV at a rest stop. Things go from bad to worse when they not only fail to find the elusive Birdie, but their ancient Winnebago breaks down as well. Forced to spend the next few days at the campground while they wait for replacement parts, Nora introduces Joseph and Annie to the eccentric campers who lovingly dub themselves the Nomads. The embers of romance begin to glow as Nora shows Joseph how to embrace the freedom of camp life. When the mystery of who Birdie is becomes clearer and the much-awaited parts arrive, allowing Joseph and Annie to finally make their Hawaiian getaway,

title: Play Date
overview: A couple shows up for a dinner party, and slowly realize it's not that kind of party.

title: Dune: Part Three
overview: Nearly two decades after he seized control of the Imperium, Paul Atreides is now a ruthless Emperor, and must face the consequences of his reign as old allies return, terrifying new threats emerge, and betrayal lurks in every shadow. Haunted by visions of Imperial collapse and the reappearance of his long-lost love, Paul is drawn into a sweeping conspiracy, with Chani at the heart of its unfolding mystery. As enemies close in, Paul must confront the true cost of power and the fate of those he loves the most.

title: Batman: Knightfall Part 2: Knightquest
overview: Batman lies broken at the hands of the villainous mastermind Bane. With Bruce Wayne paralyzed from the waist down and unable to continue as Batman, a new successor must be chosen to defend Gotham City. Jean-Paul Valley, the man also known as Azrael, must take up the mantle of the Batman. But will his more violent methods be enough to stop Bane?

title: Cheer Bloody Murder
overview: Cheerleaders attending a cheer camp are stalked by a masked murder.

title: True to the Game: Quadir's Redemption
overview: Gena and Quadir continue to establish their life together amid Quadir's complicated ties to the drug world. Questions surrounding Gena's baby threaten to permanently change their relationship.

title: Avengers: Doomsday
overview: Beloved heroes from three distinct universes are set on a deadly collision course and face an existential threat unlike anything they've ever encountered.

title: Six Months in a Pink and Blue Building
overview: Mexico City, early 90s. The day Bruno turns 11, his growing feelings for his best friend Vladimir clash with the sudden announcement that his father has HIV. Like in salsa songs, his family tries to sing and dance their pain away. Thirty years later, Bruno films and reimagine the memory of what he could not quite perceive as a child.

title: Orange-Flavoured Wedding
overview: The Puig family has seven children. And today is the wedding of the youngest: Jacques. It's March 1978 in a church in a suburb of Nantes. The father isn't attending the wedding; he's been banished from the family. Jacques is marrying Martine, a young woman who lives in the same neighborhood. It's a love match. But can love heal the wounds of childhood?

title: Viva Carmen
overview: 1845, Seville, a pulsating town of sailors and small-time crooks. Teenage Salvador, assistant to the gifted knife grinder Antonio, encounters a captivating young gypsy woman, Carmen. Her stunning beauty and independent spirit set the town abuzz, but Antonio's mystical ability to glimpse the future in sharpened blades foretells a tragic fate for Carmen at the hands of a soldier, José. With unwavering resolve, Salvador musters an eclectic band of misfit street kids, led by the spirited Belén, to challenge the unyielding threads of destiny and protect Carmen from inevitable doom.

title: Give Me Some Sugah
overview: A Chicago bakery owner is stunned by a miraculous discovery that challenges her to reclaim lost time, heal old wounds, and find purpose in the unexpected.

title: Danger
overview: Simon, a disillusioned developer, carries a secret that could dismantle modern society: a code capable of remote neural hijacking. Hunted by his former architects, he seeks sanctuary within the echoing halls of the Musée d’Orsay—one of Paris’s final "safe zones" in a world of total digital surveillance. There, among the relics of the past, he must join a clandestine resistance to protect the future of human autonomy.

title: Winter in Prostokvashino
overview: Sequel to feature film adaptation of "Prostokvashino" by K.B.A.

title: How to Survive a Marriage
overview: Maryana is a successful divorce lawyer, but her own marriage to Dima is far from ideal. On her birthday, her eccentric mother Margarita, a provincial actress, arrives unexpectedly and decides to stay, hoping to reconnect with her daughter. When Margarita claims that Dima is having an affair, Maryana begins to question her husband and their relationship, soon finding herself drawn into a family drama about love, trust, and the ways people try to stay together.

title: Три богатыря и Гуси-лебеди
overview: The swan-geese have snatched the children right from under the noses of their brave fathers: Ilya, Dobrynya, and Alyosha. There's nothing else to do but set out on a quest along rivers of milk and jelly, fending off various fairytale villains along the way, not with hands and feet, but more with your head. Resourcefulness is key in fighting geese, swans, and more important birds, like Koschey and Baba Yaga.

title: For Better And For Worse
overview: A group of friends, and the power of memory.

title: Hijamat
overview: Fifty-year-old Murad’s life is shaken to the core when he learns that his younger brother is gay. Murad would like to support his brother, but their traditional Muslim family is against it. As a result, he finds himself subjected to pressures from all sides – from his father, who has close ties to the local imam, and from his brother’s circle of friends as well. He would like to help everyone, but as he slowly falls into a spiral of conflicts and mounting difficulties, he finds that he, too, is in need of help. Another integral part of this family drama is the theme of migration and dialogue – not just between different religions, but within communities themselves.

title: 8 Segundos: O Desafio
overview: Helena is the daughter of rancher Sinval and the sister of João Donato, a renowned international rodeo champion. Her dream is to become a top female rodeo rider, despite her father’s objections, so she divides her time between secret riding practice and her work as a doctor in Barretos.

title: The Christmas Treehouse
overview: When Emma returns to her hometown for Christmas after years away, she reconnects with Ryan, who never left. Drawn together by holiday traditions and a treasured childhood treehouse, old feelings resurface, revealing that love may be closer than she imagined.

title: Order of the Dragon
overview: In a world teetering on chaos, elite assassin John Rico is the go-to solution when the government wants threats removed-quietly and permanently. But when a mission goes sideways, he's given one last shot at redemption: track down and eliminate Mason Ryker, the final ghost of the feared underground unit known as The Order of the Dragon. As Rico's mission leads him to a small, danger-ridden town in Serbia, the lines between good and evil begin to blur. Is Ryker the monster he's made out to be, or is there a deeper conspiracy at play? What begins as a black-and-white hit spirals into a moral storm-and time is running out.

title: After the Silence
overview: When his sister vanishes without a trace, a former true-crime podcaster returns to rural New England and finds himself locked in a dangerous game with a powerful man and drawn to a grieving widow who may be his only ally.

title: The Queen of Heaven
overview: The life of the Virgin Mary from the Crucifixion (33AD) till her miraculous departure/death (44AD). It also describes the early years of the Christian Church community.

title: Almost Home
overview: The feature directorial debut of Jiang Wenjie, cinematographer and editor of Keep Rolling, explores the inner lives of three female Hong Kong writers: Hon Lai-chu, Lee Wai-yi, and Human Ip. Though their styles and thematic concerns differ considerably, the film shows that their literary works are all informed by their immediate surroundings, whether that be a childhood home, the streets of Sham Shui Po, or the cattle and woods near Lai Chi Wo village. Time may inevitably erode everything in this city, but these writers continue to tell their hometown's stories in their own unique ways.

title: Hearts All Aglow
overview: Mari is a fiercely intelligent music historian who manages to get an invite to the annual Christmas gala for the local music museum and has one goal: secure an interview with Tasha the legendary Grammy award-winning singer, record producer, and museum’s founder. Mari has to summon the courage to ask the mogul who rarely does interviews these days for this favor, which proves more difficult than anticipated. Also crashing the gala is Julian, a polished and perpetually busy New York attorney on a mission of his own: his late mother received the autograph of Nat King Cole on a piece of sheet music when she was a young girl and he regrettably donated this treasured piece of family history to the DuPree Museum while emotionally numb in the aftermath of his mother’s death. Now his sister tells him she wants to give the framed sheet music to her daughter/his niece, who inherited her grandmother’s musical talent, for Christmas, and Julian is determined to bring it back home.

title: Dark Christmas
overview: When a mysterious stand-in Santa is humiliated at a luxury influencer Christmas gala, he unleashes a brutal killing spree inside a remote manor—forcing a rising social media star to fight for survival while confronting her past.

title: The Raven of Baltimore City
overview: After a deadly encounter with a purse snatcher, a comic-book-obsessed man  sets out to become a masked superhero, putting himself on course to discover his inner villain in this darkly comic crime film.

title: Baba Aama Devata Hun
overview: Baba Aama Devata Hun is nepali movie song Kumude Hidyo Hero Banna. Story about father and son

title: Barking All the Way
overview: Billie is a workaholic realtor who heads home for Christmas but her journey is derailed after a loveable but chaotic canine named Yappy almost causes her car to crash. After talking to Yappy's owner, the mysterious yet oddly familiar Mrs. C, Billie agrees to watch Yappy while she visits her grandchildren for the holidays. Yappy ends up playing the role of matchmaker and new best friend, pulling Billie towards her traveling contractor ex-boyfriend from high school, Hutch. Eager to move on, she's determined to leave Hutch in the past, but when her mother hires him to work on their shed, she finds herself spending more time with him than she ever expected. As the holidays draw closer, Billie begins to question whether chasing her dream of becoming her firm's number one seller is truly what she wants. When the mysterious Mrs. C leaves her cabin for Billie and Hutch to breathe new life into, her answer may come sooner than expected.

title: Christmas Wrapped in Love
overview: Natasha Lloyd has built a unique business helping clients locate thoughtful, one-of-a-kind gifts for the people they love. When overworked surgeon Ryan Bartlett finds himself tasked with purchasing meaningful Christmas gifts for his entire family, he hires Natasha for help. To uncover the perfect presents, Natasha agrees to pose as Ryan’s girlfriend and spend the holiday season getting to know his family. What begins as a professional arrangement soon becomes something much more as Natasha discovers the true meaning of family, belonging, and love at Christmas.

title: Love on the Christmas List
overview: An ambitious assistant teams up with a widowed father to track down the season's hottest toy, only to find herself choosing between a promotion and unexpected romance.

title: Lagarto de Celofán
overview: When the owner of their rehearsal space confiscates their instruments, the band "Cellophane Lizard" teams up with the owner of the "New York Dogs" bar to recover their instruments and fulfill their promise to the singer's deceased father: to give their first concert.

title: The Porch Pisser and the Princess
overview: The Porch Pisser and The Princess is a dark comedy about Edward, a lost teen who feels like his life has no purpose. After a strange act of rebellion against his teachers gains attention, May O’Connell, an uptight student journalist, becomes interested in his story. As the school starts panicking and the investigation grows, Edward and May get pulled into something bigger than either of them expected.

title: One Dying Star
overview: A fascinating story of science-fiction films that tried to predict the future of a socialist country that didn’t live long enough to see it.

title: Save the Date for Christmas
overview: Susie has checked out on dating while Alec is a hopeless romantic, and these longtime friends have both struck out in the love department after failing to meet the right man. After being each other's plus-one to what feels like the twentieth wedding this year, they vow to take a break from attending weddings and looking for their respective prince charming. That break doesn't last long. The next day, Susie's sister announces a last-minute Christmas wedding... and Susie convinces Alec to tag along. The objective for the week? Survive as the two lone single people and avoid family matchmaking. Over time, the Christmas wedding duties and time with family during the holidays force these two best friends to forge a new appreciation for love and marriage. Susie finds herself turning over a new leaf in pursuing romance while Alec discovers love can walk into your life when you least expect it.

title: KUMLAN
overview: This is footage recorded in 2005 and released years later. It concerns a low-budget paranormal show that was investigating the possible existence of a mysterious creature from local folklore in the forests of Thailand.

title: Punk Rock Kids
overview: Two wannabe musicians navigate the road to discovery on Christmas Eve.

title: ARASHI LIVE TOUR 2026「We are ARASHI -Prime Video Edition-」
overview: Curated and specially edited by group member Jun Matsumoto, this Farewell Special features exclusive footage from their final 5-city, 15-show stadium tour from their Live Tour 2026 「We are ARASHI 」.

title: Lau Kumude Hidyo Hero Banna
overview: Lau Kumud Hidyo Hero Banna is an inspiring music video about dreams, friendship, and the journey of becoming a hero. Kumude leaves his home in Dang with big dreams in his heart and travels to Kathmandu to become a hero. On the way, he meets his two close friends who support him and help change his style with black sunglasses, black jeans, a tough jacket, and stylish black Dingo shoes. Looking smart and confident, Kumude walks proudly like a real hero. During the journey, he meets a kind tempo rider girl who supports and encourages him. Their adventure becomes difficult when the tempo tyre gets punctured on the road. Later, a helpful truck driver gives Kumude a ride towards Kathmandu. As they travel through hills, rivers, forests, and beautiful landscapes, Kumude enjoys the beauty of Nepal and learns that becoming a hero needs courage, confidence, friendship, and belief in dreams.

title: Jumanji: Open World
overview: Our heroes have escaped the ever-changing jungles of Jumanji before, but this time the game comes to us—as Jumanji breaks free of its console, unleashing its chaos into our world.

title: The Angry Birds Movie 3
overview: Red faces his greatest challenge yet—surviving fatherhood… while saving the world.

title: Roma elastica
overview: 1982. French actress Eddie is on the verge of collapse and travels to Rome accompanied by her loyal makeup artist, Valentina, to shoot a science-fiction film – a film that could be her last one.

title: Kumaari
overview: An upcoming thriller.

title: Limbo
overview: Short film based on Kyrylo Polovinko's novel "Limbo. Place of Lost Souls"

title: The Trial
overview: Adaptation of Franz Kafka's novel "The Trial"

title: King
overview: Mentor and disciple embark on a perilous journey, pushing their survival skills to the limit against overwhelming odds and unforgiving environments.

title: Athimanoharam
overview: Sub-Inspector T. S. Lovelajan and his family navigate the grueling psychological toll of law enforcement as demanding professional duties directly clash with domestic life.

title: Dada
