overview: A stylish and uncompromising underworld don aggressively conquers the lawless Mumbai streets, weaponizing his fierce trademark justice to systematically dismantle a lethal corporate criminal syndicate.

title: Kochschule Schwarz
overview: Munich, 1938: After his traditional Jewish restaurant was destroyed by the Nazis during Kristallnacht, restaurateur Richard Schwarz and charismatic jack-of-all-trades Edgar Enders hatch a daring plan. They open a sophisticated Jewish cooking school.

title: Oceanic
overview: Adyr, a brilliant scientist working at a public university in Rio de Janeiro, conducts cutting-edge research into psychedelics as a treatment for alcoholism—the disease that claimed her husband’s life. When she becomes the target of a group seeking to appropriate her work, Adyr must fight to complete her research while protecting her own life and that of her son, Tom.

title: 5 cm: Revolusi Hati
overview: Four inseparable companions pledge lifelong solidarity upon entering secondary education, only for their collective bond to undergo severe emotional and structural strain when the introduction of romantic interests and an transformative journey outside the metropolis force them to confront the inevitable realities of maturity.

title: Philosophy of the Porch
overview: A dedicated young woman serving as her family's primary financial provider finds her matrimonial aspirations permanently derailed when she uncovers a debilitating secret: their ancestral home was pawned by her late father to finance her eldest brother's opulent wedding.

title: Autokraten
overview: In a luxurious penthouse, Diana and Stefan welcome strangers into a treacherous game of seduction, manipulation, and power. When Pan enters their world, he becomes the subject of an experiment in which charm becomes a weapon and closeness becomes a means of control. But with Olga’s arrival, a player emerges who understands the rules faster than her hosts. The balance of power shifts and control turns into a struggle for survival.

title: Hak: Tuntut atau Tunduk
overview: Hakim, an operations officer at a public market who is desperate to find money to celebrate the birth of his first child. Amidst the challenging economic pressures, the plot explores issues of oppression, the struggle for moral rights, workers' rights, and the survival of the marhaen group from external domination and an oppressive system.

title: BASTA: Start of the Game
overview: Rostov in the early 2000s was the cradle of Russian hip-hop: clubs, apartment concerts, street brawls. Basta searched for his voice, facing trials, mistrust, and hostile competitors, but it was his honest lyrics and charisma that first captivated the Rostov hip-hop community. Against the backdrop of first love, friendship, and family trials, he made his ultimate choice: to devote himself to music.

title: What They Left Us
overview: Four friends, Bara, Rafa, David and Momon celebrated their school farewell together. However, what if that togetherness turns out to be the last time?

title: Anna From Mexico
overview: Anna From Mexico Is Upcoming Kannada Movie Directed by Shankar Guru.

title: Swell
overview: The seasoned Captain Mitsos Avgoustis stubbornly refuses to retire. The ocean swell has lodged itself in his mind, and the sea simply will not give him back.  For twelve years he has been away from Greece—estranged from his family, at odds with the shipping company, yet bound by unshakable ties to the 22 sailors aboard the cargo ship ATHOS III. Defiant and unwilling to obey, he somehow keeps finding cargo, calling at ports, loading and unloading, silently roaming the waters of the Pacific.  Day and night, he battles the relentless gales on the lonely voyages of his mind and heart, where the secret he carries has long since dropped anchor.

title: Sutukai Aijanu Maya Gaijamla Relaima Chadera
overview: Sutukai Aijanu Maya Gaijamla Relaima Chadera is a romantic musical story about a dream boy who always wishes to become a film hero. One day, while walking with his sister near Gokarna Shaheed Smarak Park in Kathmandu, he sees a film song being shot. Excited by the cameras, lights, music, and dancers, he asks his sister to go closer. Among the dancers, he notices a beautiful girl whose graceful dance immediately captures his heart. He begins to imagine himself as the hero of the song, dancing and romancing with her. In his dream, they share joyful and romantic moments filled with love, laughter, and chemistry. He expresses his feelings and even proposes marriage, dreaming of spending their lives together. At the end of the song, the girl whispers in his ear, “Let’s go together.” Suddenly, the director says, “Okay, cut!” and the dream boy returns to reality. His sister takes him home, leaving him with a beautiful dream of love and his wish to become a film hero.

title: Christmas Spirit
overview: On Christmas Eve, worried Santa won't be able to see his house, a boy and his grandfather plot a holiday decoration heist.

title: Werwulf
overview: A harrowing tale of devotion, damnation and the devil within.

title: Artificial
overview: In November 2023, amidst the height of a global AI boom, OpenAI co-founder Ilya Sutskever teamed with the company board to make one of the defining decisions that has drastically reshaped the company as we know it, the firing of current CEO Sam Altman. This controversial decision would lead to immense backlash, ultimately resulting in Altman's return five days later.

title: Mr. Irrelevant
overview: The last player selected in the 1983 NFL draft by the New York Giants, underdog John Tuggle, defies expectations on and off the field for head coach Bill Parcells, his newfound love, and his team, proving that remarkable hope and perseverance can transcend even the greatest challenges.

title: Everything Else Is Noise
overview: Rosa, a contemporary music composer, agrees to give her first television interview at her colleague Tere’s apartment to keep it secret from her husband. What begins as a simple professional conversation turns into an absurd and comic portrait of rivalries and affections among three women—Rosa, Tere, and Tere’s daughter Luisa—interrupted by power outages, a constantly barking dog, and the visit of a famous composer. As the interview unravels, family and artistic tensions surface, revealing, with humor, both the fragility of prestige and the strength of complicity.

title: Sukiyaki
overview: In 1963, as Japan emerged from the shadows of war into an era of extraordinary transformation, an unlikely song made music history. "Ue o Muite Arukou," known internationally as "Sukiyaki," became the first Japanese song to top the U.S. Billboard charts, remaining at No. 1 for three weeks and captivating listeners around the world.

title: Someone Dies Tonight
overview: A group of friends sets out on a holiday road trip to Greece. On their way south, they are intercepted by a group of Croatian gangsters. Locked in a remote house, they find themselves struggling for their lives.

title: Beck 55 – The Wages of Sin
overview: Tensions are high within the overburdened Beck team when they take on a case in which a criminal family appears to be the target of a bloody act of revenge.

title: The Poolrooms
overview: A teenager trapped inside a seemingly endless aquatic labyrinth of swimming pools, towering waterslides, flooded corridors, and impossible architecture. As he ventures deeper into the surreal liminal maze and reality itself begins to unravel, a mysterious creature stalks him from beneath the water, forcing him to find a way out before he disappears forever.

title: 2nd Miracle in Cell No.7
overview: Before the events of Miracle in Cell No. 7, a devoted father fights to protect his family after a tragedy leads to a custody battle.

title: Bartu Barut
overview: The Turkish animation movie directed by Aras Ugur Kilichaslan

title: Hösten med Göran
overview: The film follows the narcissist and divorced father Göran as he tries to balance his life between having children, an expensive ADHD diagnosis and the search for love. At the same time, his best friend Alex struggles with a failing marriage. Together, they try to find joy in life, hope and maybe even love.

title: Bloodline: The Curse Within
overview: When modern medicine surrenders to an ancient curse, a renowned pediatric cardiac surgeon is forced to use the very scalpel that once saved lives to dissect the sins of his own past in a desperate fight to save his daughter from possession by a vengeful spirit born of a buried history.

title: Chiranjeevi Hanuman: The Eternal
overview: An AI-generated film about the Hindu god Hanuman; it will draw from the sacred texts of Indian epic 'Ramayana' and Puranic literature to create what producers describe as an “awe-inspiring, visual odyssey designed to be enjoyed as a shared experience in theaters.”

title: Haunted Carnival
overview: As the carnival turns into a death trap, the guests must survive challenges while carnival freaks hunt every single one of them.

title: Kyllä isä osaa Espanjassa
overview: Despite his family’s objections, The Father decides to make his dream of spending his retirement in Spain a reality. But how will Finland’s most famous family fare under the Spanish sun, amid cockroaches, their first steps in salsa dancing, and beach chairs?  And will The Father strike the deal of a lifetime with his real estate investments—or will he lose everything?

title: Bye Bye Love: Detective Is in the Bar
overview: Two cases lead a detective and Takada into a dark conspiracy. What truth lies beyond the white snow?

title: Amir
overview: A gifted 10-year-old boy who can see mythical creatures must warn a skeptical village of the impending catastrophe.

title: The Greatest Showdown
overview: After an explosive first encounter, two business owners become rivals. Their all-out war may cost them everything they've worked for.

title: A Perfect Marriage
overview: An official entry to the 52nd Metro Manila Film Festival.

title: wyrdo
overview: A Christmas dinner party is interrupted by an uninvited guest.

title: Dunk the Halls: San Antonio Spurs vs. New York Knicks Rematch
overview: Dunk the Halls is back for year three! This year, Angel joins Stitch and the rest of the Disney crew for a real-time animated rematch of the 2026 NBA Finals.

title: Bike Ambulance Dada
overview: Based on the life of Padma Shri Karimul Haque. The world's first bike ambulance man who has saved over 7,000 lives.

title: Red Flag Bhalobasha Beshi
overview: Dibyojyoti Dutta stars opposite Divyani Mondal.

title: ViQueens
overview: Fearless Viking girls Ingrid and Hedvig defy tradition to return a stowaway boy to China. Their journey spans icy fjords, Byzantine intrigue, and the fabled Silk Road, blending Viking grit with ancient Chinese wisdom, unexpected alliances, and a touch of magic.

title: unbearableness
overview: When emotional blindness and loneliness collide, bizarre chain of events unravels.

title: The Audition
overview: A struggling actor, Nikhil Dagga , 31 stands at the brink of surrender. Broke and beaten down, he retreats to a claustrophobic Mumbai apartment where intrusive neighbors and mounting debts test his resolve. When his final chance at redemption collapses, one desperate, late-night performance becomes an unexpected act of rebellion.

title: Until the Day Ends
overview: Two teenagers protesting political repression must flee, taking with them only their love and a dog.

title: Apophis 2029
overview: On April 13, 2029, the asteroid Apophis will pass close enough to Earth, it will be below our satellites. It will dip below and pop back out.

title: The Daughters of Abraham
overview: After several years apart, Myriam, a young woman from a Muslim background who grew up in Marseille, reconnects with Eva, who comes from a Jewish family, during the summer vacation. Together, they live out their youth outside the imposed norms. But this carefree summer begins to unravel when a tragedy upends the balance of their social and family circles—and soon, their own destinies.

title: The Man Who Flew Away
overview: Sarah Chardonnet is 45 years old and has three children. She was also the wife of Paul Chardonnet—nicknamed “Walker”—who has just died in a plane crash while piloting his own aircraft. A brilliant entrepreneur with an increasingly bright future ahead of him, Walker is suddenly gone. Now a widow, Sarah finds herself left in charge of FlyEuropExpress, a logistics firm that has become the European leader in express transport—a company that must somehow be kept running. It is with anger that she receives François Schneider, a private investigator specializing in missing persons, who has been commissioned by FlyEuropExpress’s insurance company to confirm that Walker is indeed dead. The fact is, no body has been recovered…

title: New Recruit: Haunted Military Hospital
overview: Seeking a sweet escape, a group of rookie soldiers is admitted to what they believe is a paradise-like military hospital, only to uncover its dark secrets as they confront a series of terrifying rumors.

title: Stab
overview: In an isolated suburban house, 17-year-old Emma Sterling, left home alone for the night, is awakened by the ringing of the landline phone. After a brief, reassuring call from her parents, a mysterious caller takes control of the line and forces her to participate in a deadly quiz on classic horror movies.

title: Dawn of Soengsang
overview: In the era when the communists ruled the city, the red zone of the struggle for power, hid the evil legend of the forest, roaring and fanging, occupying the haunted land for hundreds of years.

title: Pendulum
overview: A couple, journeys to a retreat in New Mexico seeking healing. Patrick grows skeptical of the retreat's leader as Abigail falls under her influence. They wonder if the group's practices offer genuine healing or conceal a terrifying truth.

title: Eurotrash
overview: A writer sets off on a road trip through Switzerland with his drunk and terminally ill mother, after realizing his wealthy family members are the very worst kind of people.

title: The House That Zombies Built
overview: Zombies have overrun the earth, and young Scott's the last to learn about it - so he can't be too picky when it comes to choosing his safe haven.

title: Beneran Horor
overview: Joe, a film director, is shooting a horror movie on a remote island with his crew. A critical error, however, leads them to the wrong location—a mysterious territory inhabited by creatures that should never be disturbed. When Joe finds himself in need of extras, the crew encounters these "inhabitants," mistakenly believing they were summoned by Opie. Unsuspecting, the crew treats the creatures just like ordinary extras—until the situation takes a turn that is both tense and absurd.

title: The Caged
overview: A family is terrorised by a dark presence after they move into a quaint cottage, and discover it lies on the site of a medieval prison which once housed women accused of witchcraft.

title: Fission
overview: A man recalls his childhood in 1950s West Germany as a nine-year-old boy discovering his father’s clandestine work with a dominant family guest—a time when his fear of the Sandman of folklore may have resurfaced in his own act of cruelty.

title: Пиковая дама: Последнее желание
overview: Igor’s solitary routine is unexpectedly disrupted by the arrival of his ex-wife and their two children. While jokingly attempting to summon a spirit from a mirror, the teenagers inadvertently awaken an evil linked to Igor—one he had long since forgotten. Now, his only chance to protect his loved ones from the vengeful Queen of Spades is to recall the price he once paid to secure his own salvation.

title: Tengo un Hombre en la Cabeza
The Devil's Due
overview: For inquisitor Jude Price, sobriety meant leaving his demons behind. But when a trail of strange disappearances leads back to his former local, he realises they've been awaiting his return.

title: Any Other Night
overview: On the night of a crippling transit strike in Berlin, two strangers are thrown together while their personal lives fall apart. After Maggie’s every possession is packed into Sam’s taxi, they discover a spark. But as the meter ticks – and the night gets weirder – it dawns that timing might be everything.

title: The First Gokturk: Prologue
overview: This rebellion, which began with Bumin, Istemi, and his mentor Alagar, will write the epic of a people who broke their chains and re-emerged on the stage of history.

title: Marie-Rose and the Mysterious Journey
overview: Marie-Rose and the Mysterious Journey is an animated 3D feature film based on the iconic show of Chantal Goya.

title: Quarantine
overview: The film follows a May 1st protest in Paris, from the intensity of collective struggle to the quiet return to the suburbs. Between a day of political resistance and a simple public holiday, it explores what remains of collective action once the crowd disperses.

title: Not All Men
overview: After breaking free from a long, toxic relationship, Fernanda embarks on a weekend getaway with three friends, seeking solace and distraction. However, what begins as an escape quickly devolves into a whirlwind of tension and hidden agendas, as the group's true intentions come to light, forcing Fernanda to confront the reality she sought to escape.

title: The Selling Stage
overview: At the end of a twenty-five-year career, LuFisto confronts the cost of chasing a dream that asked for everything and gave back less than promised.

title: The Wyverns
overview: Jura, summer 1912. Two sisters, Marie (11 years old) and Suzanne (15), flee their daily lives for  cross the forest and reach the cave of the Vouivre, legendary female figure and  incarnation of nature, supposed to devour those who dare to challenge it. Between belief and  emancipation, their expedition takes an unexpected turn. The Vouivre may not exist  Not but the myth becomes a weapon.

title: Forbidden Bonds (Entre el Deseo y el Pecado)
La Reina, el Buda y Buñuel
MOBIUS
overview: Trapped in his isolated apartment during a late-night writing session, a struggling author finds himself unable to finish the book he is writing.
